notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Food.
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate a Food you control by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain 3 life.
Treebeard's second ability and Prize Pig trigger.
Resolve the Prize Pig trigger, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters from it and untapping it.
Resolve the Treebeard trigger, putting three +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Repeat.
